# resolve_peer()

**Qualified name:** `pyrogram.Client.resolve_peer`

## Signature

```python
async def resolve_peer(peer_id: Union[int, str]) -> Union[raw.base.InputPeer, raw.base.InputUser, raw.base.InputChannel]: ...
```

## Documentation

Get the InputPeer of a known peer id.
Useful whenever an InputPeer type is required.

> [!NOTE]
> This is a utility method intended to be used **only** when working with raw
> available yet in the Client class as an easy-to-use method).

**Available to:** User accounts and bots.

### Parameters

- **`peer_id`** (`int` | `str`)
  The peer id you want to extract the InputPeer from.
  Can be a direct id (int), a username (str) or a phone number (str) or *t.me/<username>* link.

### Returns

`InputPeer`: On success, the resolved peer id is returned in form of an InputPeer object.

### Raises

KeyError: In case the peer doesn't exist in the internal database.
